0022600223.text: The Pelicans (4-7, 12th in the West) host the Nets (2-8, 13th in the East) in this 12th game of New Orleans' season, with the Pelicans on a three-game losing streak and 3-3 at home. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), both out, and Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise, out) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness), who is day-to-day and a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Pelicans winning the last meeting 116-113 in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
